title: BuySell Technologies Moves from Perimeter-Based Security to Zero Trust with Netskope SASE/SSE to Support Rapid Business Growth
summary: Founded in 2001, BuySell Technologies Co., Ltd. has achieved an exceptional 67.8% year-over-year revenue growth rate in the reuse industry. As the company expanded its business, grew its workforce, and actively pursued mergers and acquisitions (M&A), the limitations of its existing perimeter-based security model became increasingly apparent. To address challenges including growing use of networks outside the corporate perimeter, the proliferation of shadow IT, inconsistent security policies across group companies, and the risk of data leakage in the cloud, BuySell Technologies deployed Netskope SASE/SSE and transitioned to a zero trust security model. The rollout began in 2025 and was completed across the entire group in August 2026, establishing a security foundation for continued growth. Looking ahead, the company also plans to expand visibility into shadow AI.
body_markdown:
Netskope has enabled BuySell Technologies to control access to websites that pose security risks while also gaining visibility into shadow IT. Maehara explains how the company plans to build on that visibility. “Now that we can identify shadow IT, we will use the data we have gained to implement appropriate controls. Going forward, we also want to detect and control how data is moved and exchanged in the cloud, as well as data being taken out of remote environments. With DLP, we plan to detect and block the leakage of sensitive information in real time.”


Finally, Senbo discusses the company’s plans for the future. “As AI adoption expands within our company, we are considering AI controls through Netskope One AI Security so that we can gain visibility into which AI services are approved by the company and which are not. TED continues to provide us with the latest information and recommendations on AI controls and related technologies. We also want to use the visibility provided by Netskope to standardize the tools and services used across the group, helping us reduce security risks and optimize costs. By addressing the challenges that come with expanding AI adoption and building on the zero trust foundation provided by Netskope, we aim to support the company’s continued growth.”


Guided by its vision, “Leading the circular economy with exceptional people and new technologies,” BuySell Technologies continues to expand its reuse business. Zero trust powered by Netskope SASE/SSE provides a security foundation to support the company as it works toward realizing that vision.
